Feature: Self-Test and Pre-Test Mode Validation

  Scenario: Validate flow sensor accuracy
    Given the blower is set to a certain speed
    And the air lines are open
    And nothing is connected to the output
    When the self-test is performed
    Then the flow sensor should give the expected flow value

  Scenario Outline: Validate pressure sensor accuracy
    Given the pressure sensor is calibrated
    When the self-test is performed with pressure <value>
    Then the pressure sensor should read <expected_value>
    Examples:
      | kind     | value | expected_value |
      | positive | 100   | 100            |
      | negative | -10   | 0              |
      | boundary | 0     | 0              |
      | boundary | 200   | 200            |

  Scenario: Controller supports pre-test mode
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the pre-test mode is activated
    Then the controller should enter pre-test mode

  Scenario: GUI supports controller's pre-test mode
    Given the GUI is displayed
    And the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the user activates the pre-test mode from the GUI
    Then the GUI should indicate that the controller is in pre-test mode

  Scenario Outline: Controller's pre-test mode includes checks
    Given the controller is in pre-test mode
    When the pre-test mode performs check <check_name> with value <value>
    Then the check <check_name> should pass with result <expected_result>
    Examples:
      | kind     | check_name       | value | expected_result |
      | positive | flow_sensor      | 100   | pass            |
      | negative | flow_sensor      | -10   | fail            |
      | boundary | flow_sensor      | 0     | pass            |
      | boundary | flow_sensor      | 200   | pass            |
      | positive | pressure_sensor  | 100   | pass            |
      | negative | pressure_sensor  | -10   | fail            |
      | boundary | pressure_sensor  | 0     | pass            |
      | boundary | pressure_sensor  | 200   | pass            |
